text:
Donaldson Capital Management LLC increased its holdings in shares of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 0.9% during the 3rd quarter, according to the company in its most recent 13F filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission. The firm owned 200,565 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after buying an additional 1,866 shares during the period. Apple comprises 3.2% of Donaldson Capital Management LLC’s investment portfolio, making the stock its 9th largest holding. Donaldson Capital Management LLC’s holdings in Apple were worth $30,911,000 as of its most recent SEC filing. 
A number of other institutional investors and hedge funds have also made changes to their positions in the stock. Davis Rea LTD. grew its holdings in Apple by 1.9% during the 3rd quarter. Davis Rea LTD. now owns 35,934 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $5,538,000 after acquiring an additional 665 shares in the last quarter. Cipher Capital LP acquired a new position in Apple during the 3rd quarter worth approximately $1,763,000. Columbia Partners L L C Investment Management grew its holdings in Apple by 6.0% during the 3rd quarter. Columbia Partners L L C Investment Management now owns 167,696 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $25,845,000 after acquiring an additional 9,464 shares in the last quarter. Check Capital Management Inc. CA grew its holdings in Apple by 100.0% during the 3rd quarter. Check Capital Management Inc. CA now owns 18,680 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $2,879,000 after acquiring an additional 9,340 shares in the last quarter. Finally, Pictet North America Advisors SA grew its holdings in Apple by 1.6% during the 3rd quarter. Pictet North America Advisors SA now owns 249,495 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $38,452,000 after acquiring an additional 3,857 shares in the last quarter. 59.70% of the stock is currently owned by hedge funds and other institutional investors. Apple Inc. ( AAPL ) opened at $176.21 on Friday. The company has a market cap of $894,091.88, a price-to-earnings ratio of 18.11, a price-to-earnings-growth ratio of 1.33 and a beta of 1.19. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.74, a quick ratio of 1.20 and a current ratio of 1.24. Apple Inc. has a 12-month low of $137.05 and a 12-month high of $180.62. Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last announced its quarterly earnings results on Thursday, February 1st. The iPhone maker reported $3.89 earnings per share (EPS) for the quarter, beating the Zacks’ consensus estimate of $3.82 by $0.07. The business had revenue of $88.29 billion during the quarter, compared to the consensus estimate of $87.62 billion. Apple had a net margin of 21.13% and a return on equity of 37.37%. The business’s revenue was up 12.7% compared to the same quarter last year. During the same quarter last year, the firm posted $3.36 EPS. sell-side analysts expect that Apple Inc. will post 11.43 earnings per share for the current year. 
The business also recently declared a quarterly dividend, which was paid on Thursday, February 15th. Stockholders of record on Monday, February 12th were issued a $0.63 dividend. The ex-dividend date of this dividend was Friday, February 9th. This represents a $2.52 dividend on an annualized basis and a dividend yield of 1.43%. Apple’s dividend payout ratio is presently 25.90%. 
AAPL has been the subject of several analyst reports. Macquarie set a $188.00 price target on shares of Apple and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a report on Friday, January 26th. ValuEngine upgraded shares of Apple from a “hold” rating to a “buy” rating in a report on Sunday, December 31st. Zacks Investment Research upgraded shares of Apple from a “hold” rating to a “buy” rating and set a $197.00 price target for the company in a report on Thursday, January 18th. Barclays lowered their price target on shares of Apple from $174.00 to $170.00 and set an “equal weight” rating for the company in a report on Friday, February 2nd. Finally, Piper Jaffray Companies reiterated a “buy” rating and set a $200.00 price target on shares of Apple in a report on Tuesday, January 2nd. One analyst has rated the stock with a sell rating, seventeen have given a hold rating, thirty-four have given a buy rating and one has given a strong buy rating to the stock. Apple currently has a consensus rating of “Buy” and an average price target of $201.58. 
In other news, insider Daniel J. Riccio sold 15,641 shares of the stock in a transaction dated Thursday, December 7th. The shares were sold at an average price of $169.69, for a total value of $2,654,121.29. Following the completion of the transaction, the insider now owns 17,341 shares in the company, valued at approximately $2,942,594.29. The sale was disclosed in a legal filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission, which is accessible through the SEC website . Company insiders own 0.08% of the company’s stock.

Apple Profile 
Apple Inc (Apple) designs, manufactures and markets mobile communication and media devices, personal computers, and portable digital music players, and a variety of related software, services, peripherals, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications. The Company’s products and services include iPhone, iPad, Mac, iPod, Apple TV, a portfolio of consumer and professional software applications, the iOS and OS X operating systems, iCloud, and a variety of accessory, service and support offerings.
